verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is SDK- and CLI-first. It documents programmatic APIs for LLM generation and streaming, chat, tool calling, structured output, STT, TTS, VAD, voice agents, VLM, image generation and model downloads, plus an OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint and CLI account and usage commands. It never documents explicit API/UI parity, cloud authentication relies on an interactive browser approval step, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: an explicit parity claim or comparison of UI vs API, a non-browser programmatic auth/account-management path, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so the official OpenAI clients work by pointing `base_url` at it.
Check it with `wally account whoami`, and see what you have spent with `wally account usage`.
`RunAnywhere.voice` assembles speech-to-text, a language model, and text-to-speech into one session that listens, thinks, and answers out loud.
`RunAnywhere.images` generates an image from a prompt.
